notes.title: Update 1.0.1 is live!
notes.content:
Hello, welcome to the first update to Cook Off!
Basically just bug fixes.

here are change logs!
[h3]v 1.0.1[/h3]
Bubblehead bug fixes and balancing
- Adjusted electric wall placement during bubblehead recovery patterns
- Fixed an issue that out of the screen in the dash pattern
- Fixed an issue that the results screen not appearing

- Adjusted gun sound and ui sound effects volume
- Added boss slashable UI display
- Improved camera movement
